observation_provenance: Root Codex supplied actual official-viewer fresh1–5 body/prefix matches, prefix labels, first-p local functions, scene hashes/metadata and past/current/reward judgements. Child agent assembled these with existing source records; child did not reopen original body.

normalization.scene_character_denominator: sum normalized nonempty p lengths, excluding join LF

first1000_rubric.unit: Every nonempty display-p intersection with exact1000UTF16 including join LF; multi-label A/E/I plus F fragment
first1000_rubric.F: Too-short boundary fragment without identifiable full function
first1000_rubric.boundary_notes: 1p65 includes7UTF16 and3p69 includes5UTF16: F only.2p48 contains17UTF16 of past-history E.5p73 includes5UTF16 of family-name E without full-name inference.4p69 ends998 and final twoLF complete1000; p71 starts1000 and is excluded.
first1000_rubric.root_reported_method: A/E/I/F nonexclusive display intersection presence; not unique atomic info/clause percentages. E historical narrated action not current performed A. Last1p65/3p69 fragments F. 2p48 clipped past-history E;5p73 clipped family-name E without full-name inference.
first1000_rubric.cut_coordinate_system: First slice normalized body including join LF to1000UTF16; then calculate text-only presence denominator from its intersections
first1000_rubric.unassignable_fragment_policy: F only when clipped fragment is insufficient to identify a function; never complete names or actions beyond cut. F is not included in a content-function total.

source_hash_method: SHA256 of UTF8 file text after CRLF -> LF normalization, not OS-specific raw bytes
